activity_summary: After the Errors you came out of Egeon. Kemp was civil and did not offer you a line. You did not open a tally. Garnish said nothing was bought, and that the Rose had a Venetian comedy. You stayed at the Cross Keys and did not go over the water.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Left the part, refused a tally, and stayed on this side of the river.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Stayed civil and said he had no line to sell.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Said the bill was walked, that nothing was bought, and named the Rose's afternoon.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Mentioned in Out of the old man

entities.name: the Venetian comedy
entities.context: Mentioned in Out of the old man

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: You are out of the old man.
